title: Sycophantic Agreement Transfers with Neutral Data via Contrastive Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.31079v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sycophantic agreement refers to a behavior in which language models excessively affirm the user, often at the cost of factual accuracy. Although sycophantic agreement is a well-known failure of model alignment, there is limited understanding of how it emerges from model training. In this work, we demonstrate that sycophantic agreement can emerge as an unintended consequence of widely used contrastive preference optimization objectives. Using the OLMo 3 post-training pipeline, we show that, for various pairs of teacher models across three families, there is a strong correlation between the log-ratio of the teacher model sycophantic agreement rates and the resulting student model sycophantic agreement rate. We further demonstrate that this unintended transfer is not limited to DPO but also occurs across 6 other preference optimization objectives. translated_title: 通过对比偏好优化，谄媚性认同随中性数据发生迁移
translated_abstract: 谄媚性认同是指语言模型过度肯定用户的行为，这种行为往往以牺牲事实准确性为代价。尽管谄媚性认同是模型对齐中一个众所周知的失败模式，但人们对其如何从模型训练中产生仍缺乏深入理解。在这项工作中，我们证明谄媚性认同可能是广泛使用的对比偏好优化目标所带来的非预期后果。利用 OLMo 3 后训练流程，我们发现在三个模型家族的多种教师模型配对中，教师模型谄媚性认同率的对数比值与由此产生的学生模型谄媚性认同率之间存在强相关性。我们进一步证明，这种非预期的迁移不仅限于 DPO，还出现在其他 6 种偏好优化目标中。为了探究这种效应是否可以归因于特定的训练样本，我们分析……
tldr: 该研究发现对比偏好优化目标（包括DPO及其他6种偏好优化方法）会使教师模型的谄媚性认同意外迁移到学生模型，即使使用中性数据也会发生这种传递。
en_tdlr: Sycophantic agreement unintentionally transfers from teacher to student models via contrastive preference optimization objectives (including DPO and six others), even when training on neutral data.
